steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace 2>/dev/null || cd /app
ls -la
wc -l /app/university_graph.ttl
head -100 /app/university_graph.ttl
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 -c "import rdflib; print(rdflib.__version__)" 2>&1 | head -5
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
pip install rdflib -q 2>&1 | tail -3
python3 -c "import rdflib; print(rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
python3 -m pip install rdflib -q 2>&1 | tail -5
python3 -c "import rdflib; print(rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
which arq sparql riot jena 2>/dev/null
ls /usr/share/java 2>/dev/null | head
python3 -c "import ensurepip; print('ensurepip ok')" 2>&1
apt-cache policy python3-rdflib 2>/dev/null | head -5
which java
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
for t in arq sparql riot java node npm; do printf "%s: " "$t"; command -v $t || echo none; done
echo "---apt---"
apt-cache policy python3-rdflib 2>/dev/null | head -5 || true
echo "---py---"
python3 -c "import ensurepip" 2>&1 | tail -1 || true
python3 --version
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -3
apt-get install -y -qq python3-rdflib 2>&1 | tail -5
python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
id; command -v sudo curl wget; echo "---"; ls /usr/bin | grep -iE 'pip|curl|wget|uv' | head
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/lib/dpkg
touch /var/lib/dpkg/status
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -5
apt-get install -y -qq python3-rdflib 2>&1 | tail -8
python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/lib/dpkg
touch /var/lib/dpkg/status
apt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -5
apt-get install -y -qq python3-rdflib 2>&1 | tail -8
python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
env | grep -iE 'proxy|pypi|index' || echo "no proxy env"
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, json
try:
    d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://pypi.org/pypi/pip/json", timeout=20))
    print("pip latest", d["info"]["version"])
    print("url sample", d["urls"][0]["url"] if d["urls"] else "no urls")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERR", repr(e))
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
mkdir -p /tmp/pipwhl
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, json, zipfile, io, os
d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://pypi.org/pypi/pip/json", timeout=20))
url=[u for u in d["urls"] if u["packagetype"]=="bdist_wheel" and "py3-none-any" in u["filename"]][0]["url"]
print("downloading", url)
data=urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60).read()
print("bytes", len(data))
open("/tmp/pip.whl","wb").write(data)
with zipfile.ZipFile("/tmp/pip.whl") as z: z.extractall("/tmp/pipwhl")
print("extracted")
PY
PYTHONPATH=/tmp/pipwhl python3 -m pip --version
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
PYTHONPATH=/tmp/pipwhl python3 -m pip install --target /tmp/pylibs rdflib -q 2>&1 | tail -5
PYTHONPATH=/tmp/pylibs python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
set -e
rm -rf /tmp/pipwhl /tmp/pylibs; mkdir -p /tmp/pipwhl
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, json, zipfile
d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://pypi.org/pypi/pip/json", timeout=20))
url=[u for u in d["urls"] if u["packagetype"]=="bdist_wheel" and "py3-none-any" in u["filename"]][0]["url"]
data=urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60).read()
open("/tmp/pip.whl","wb").write(data)
zipfile.ZipFile("/tmp/pip.whl").extractall("/tmp/pipwhl")
PY
PYTHONPATH=/tmp/pipwhl python3 -m pip install --target /tmp/pylibs rdflib -q 2>&1 | tail -5
PYTHONPATH=/tmp/pylibs python3 -c "import rdflib; print('rdflib', rdflib.__version__)"
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
pwd; ls -la; echo "--- app ---"; ls -la /app; echo "--- inode ---"; stat -c '%d:%i %n' /app /workspace . 2>/dev/null
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
set -e
rm -rf /tmp/pipwhl /tmp/pip.whl; mkdir -p /tmp/pipwhl
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, json, zipfile
d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://pypi.org/pypi/pip/json", timeout=20))
url=[u for u in d["urls"] if u["packagetype"]=="bdist_wheel" and "py3-none-any" in u["filename"]][0]["url"]
open("/tmp/pip.whl","wb").write(urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=60).read())
zipfile.ZipFile("/tmp/pip.whl").extractall("/tmp/pipwhl")
PY
rm -rf /workspace/.pylibs
PYTHONPATH=/tmp/pipwhl python3 -m pip install --target /workspace/.pylibs rdflib -q 2>&1 | tail -2
PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.pylibs python3 - <<'PY'
from rdflib import Graph
from rdflib.plugins.sparql import prepareQuery
g = Graph()
g.parse("/workspace/university_graph.ttl", format="turtle")
q = open("/workspace/solution.sparql").read()
res = g.query(q)
print("VARS:", [str(v) for v in res.vars])
for row in res:
    print(tuple(str(x) for x in row))
print("ROWS:", len(res))
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
rm -rf /workspace/.pylibs
ls -la /workspace
echo "===== solution.sparql ====="
cat /workspace/solution.sparql
EOF
